messages:
Rae (Product): Quick post-lab note: users were confused by the lack of overall progress in the Private setup network step. They wanted a clear "how far along" indicator, not just a list of probes.
Tom (Design): Agreed. Proposed pattern: sticky slim summary bar at top of step with a micro progress bar + text 'Network readiness: 2/5 checks passed'. Keeps the detail area collapsible.
Sasha (Eng): Backend can calculate pass/fail counts and emit a `diagnostics_overview` payload every 5s. It would include total, passed, pending, and an optional `eta_seconds`.
Ivy (Frontend): Frontend plan: render sticky bar with role="region" aria-label="Network readiness" and an accessible progressbar that announces percentage changes only. The detailed list stays below and is toggled.
Rae (Product): Copy suggestion for the bar: 'Network readiness — 2 of 5 checks passed (ETA ~20s)'. Avoid words like 'failure' up-front.
Tom (Design): Visuals: 36px bar, high-contrast progress color + patterned fill for 'pending' to meet contrast + colorblind-friendly pattern. Make the bar non-interactive but include a small 'Show details' action.
Sasha (Eng): We can add an `eta_seconds` field; caution that early probes can be misleading. Maybe remove ETA after first failure. Also emitting `step_hint` strings for the bar to show short troubleshooting hints like 'Check firewall rules'.
Ivy (Frontend): Accessibility notes: announce summary updates with aria-live="polite" and only when the percent increments by >=5% or when pass_count changes to reduce spam. Keyboard: provide a 'focusable' Show details button and ensure expand scrolls focus into the first failing probe.
A11yBot: +1. Also ensure progressbar has aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax and a textual fallback '2 of 5 checks passed'. Do not use only color.
OpsBot: Telemetry note: emit analytic event `network_overview_shown` with fields `passed_count`, `total_count`, `duration_s` so we can measure user confusion -> ticket correlation.
Rae (Product): UX copy tweak: change expanded heading from 'Network checks' -> 'Network diagnostics' and include a short helper: 'These checks typically finish within 30s. If anything fails, click "Show details".'
Tom (Design): Microcopy for failing probe CTA: 'Troubleshoot' (opens KB) instead of 'What it means'. Also keep the per-probe timestamp in the details view only.
Sasha (Eng): Backend schema example to support this: ```json
{
  "type": "diagnostics_overview",
  "total": 5,
  "passed": 2,
  "pending": 3,
  "eta_seconds": 20,
  "hints": ["Check egress on port 443"]
}
```
Ivy (Frontend): I'll prototype the sticky bar + progress pattern and the expand flow. Will include keyboard and screen-reader walkthrough in the mock. Posting Figma link here by Wed.
Rae (Product): Action items: Sasha add `diagnostics_overview` events, Ivy mock + a11y walkthrough, Tom finalize patterns & patterned fill, A11yBot to review. Target: next sprint.
Tom (Design): One more small thing: when user clicks 'Retry all' in the details view, show a subtle confirmation toast 'Re-running network checks'. Avoid full page reloads.
Sasha (Eng): We'll add a `retry_all` endpoint and emit `diagnostics_overview` with `retries` count.
Rae (Product): Thanks team. Hoping this reduces "wizard seems stuck" reports and gives users a clearer signal of progress. :sparkles:
